rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only speed controller needs anticipatory continuous caution without sacrificing valid completion.
observable_information: Successful TRAIN stable-control pixels and inherited actions, with TRAIN-only shadow geometry teacher target-speed labels; inference will use pixels and inherited action only.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Train one continuous target-speed pixel regressor, save tensor-only checkpoint; teacher never drives and no student driving occurs in this run.
expected_success_endpoint: At least 100 low-target training labels, 20 validation labels and predictions below 55, finite validation loss and at least 10% lower MAE than constant-60 baseline.
control: Unchanged stable-risk pixel driver on twelve new TRAIN cells; constant-60 prediction as within-TRAIN validation baseline.
falsifier: Insufficient low-speed label support, collapsed predictions, no validation MAE gain, unsafe checkpoint, teacher action execution or privileged inference input.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Twelve unchanged-control TRAIN rollouts tracks 1-3 x seeds 5032-5035; 5035 held for within-TRAIN validation.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU local training profile capped at 1,800 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no TUNE, held-out, confirmation, blind or external action.
